findings.title: Stale model-eval recommendations remain labeled “act now”
findings.what: The workbench uses isActNowRoutingGap solely as a score/evidence/veto predicate and prints “act now” regardless of summary.generatedAt. The dispatched test proves the behavior with a summary generated on 2026-06-10 while still expecting “act now”; by the audit date that evidence is over 14 days old. Although the result-history card displays the summary date elsewhere, the actionable status itself is not demoted to “as of 2026-06-10.”
findings.fix: Apply the summary freshness policy when choosing the row status. For stale summaries, replace the current green “act now” label with a non-current label such as “as of YYYY-MM-DD” while retaining the score, evidence, rationale, and approval framing. Update the test to pin time and assert the stale label.
findings.acceptance: With time pinned later than the freshness window and generatedAt set to 2026-06-10, the recommendation row contains “as of 2026-06-10” and does not contain “act now”; a summary inside the freshness window still renders “act now (needs your approval).”
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed src/components/ModelEvalsPf.tsx:398 calls the score/evidence/veto helper directly and does not pass or compare time. The smallest related baseline check found the helper's freshness constant is 14 days but its exported row predicate performs no generatedAt check. The dispatched test independently reproduces the defect by expecting “act now” from its 2026-06-10 fixture.
